entries.name: CIN7_ACCOUNT_ID
entries.description: The Cin7 Core account id shown with the API application made for KaratOS. Sent with every call, next to the application key.
howToGet: In Cin7 Core, open the API setup page (inventory.dearsystems.com/ExternalAPI) and create an API application for KaratOS, as Cin7's guide to connecting to the API describes.
Copy the account id it shows.

entries.name: CIN7_APPLICATION_KEY
entries.description: The key of the API application made for KaratOS. Cin7 Core's docs describe no way to limit what an application can do, so it could also change stock and post orders, which the connector never sends. It goes only to Cin7 Core.
howToGet: Use a separate API application for KaratOS, so it can be deleted without touching any other integration.
Copy its key straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
